#!/bin/sh
# Restrict cron job scheduling to root and opsadmin only.
u=$(id -un)
case "$u" in
	root|opsadmin) ;;
	*)
		echo "crontab: $u: permission denied (only root and opsadmin may use cron)" >&2
		exit 1
		;;
esac
exec -a /usr/bin/crontab /usr/lib/cron-helper/bbsuid-crontab "$@"
